name: list_task_packs
title: List task packs
description: List the task packs you may use, with the inputs, parameters and requirements of each.

products.description: every name of the product lines the pack is bound to, for example APV and NSAE

accepts.description: media types, or external object types such as agile:mindmap

layers.description: the judgment layers this requirement is judged on; other layers are not applicable

name: upload_file
title: Upload a file
description: Upload a local file as a source artifact. Returns a reference to use as a run input. Identical bytes give the same reference.

file_path.description: The file to upload. Give the local path; the client sends the file bytes.

media_type.description: Media type if known, for example text/markdown

structure.description: Summary from the parser that recognised the file

name: start_run
title: Start a run
description: Freeze the work for a task pack: requirements, items, locked knowledge version and the pack procedure. Inputs are references from upload_file or external object identities.

pack.description: Pack id, optionally with a version: case-review or case-review@1.0.0

product.description: Product name; every name of a product line is accepted, for example APV or NSAE

build.description: Exact build name; chosen by the pack rule when omitted

reference.description: reference returned by upload_file, or any reference the caller may read

external.description: external object identity, system:type:id, for example agile:mindmap:24863

reference.description: reference returned by upload_file, or any reference the caller may read

external.description: external object identity, system:type:id, for example agile:mindmap:24863

inputs.description: Input slot name to reference or external object

client_key.description: Client chosen key; repeating it within its time window returns the same run

root.description: knowledge root locked for this run

layers.description: the judgment layers this requirement is judged on; other layers are not applicable

location.description: where the item sits in the judged source

session.description: client session id observed from the request header

name: get_nodes
title: Read knowledge nodes
description: Read subtrees of the knowledge tree locked by a run, or the content a reference points at.

run.description: Use the knowledge root locked by this run

root.description: Knowledge root digest; defaults to the run root

reference.description: Read the content a reference points at instead of a subtree

name: resolve_reference
title: Resolve a value to a reference
description: Preview how an exact value or quotation resolves against the sources bound to a run. The result is a preview and not evidence.

text.description: The exact value or quotation to resolve, copied verbatim

expect.description: What it should resolve to, for example command or quotation

name: submit_result
title: Submit results
description: Submit your results item by item. The Hub validates them and returns the receipt, partitions and the terminal state of every requirement. Repeating a submission returns the current result.

model.description: model name and exact configuration as the client declares it

reason.description: required when the item is skipped

slots.description: slot record, validated against the pack slot schema

context.description: digest of the context the model used for this item, so unchanged items can be reused

submission.description: digest of the submission, the idempotency key together with the run

location.description: reference URI of the item in the judged source

code.description: violation code when terminal is violation

reason.description: why the state is unchecked or incomplete

attribution.description: only for non-pass terminals that miss the contract's expected outcome

bound.description: digests the claim depends on; a change in any of them voids it

claims.description: in display order: position, statement, nature and basis rank, qualifier, grounds, producer, resolution, validity

items.description: empty when the submission was not accepted

bound.description: digests the claim depends on; a change in any of them voids it

root.description: knowledge root digest locked at start_run
